verdict.rationale: Mollie Components (Mollie JS) lets developers add credit-card fields directly to their own checkout with PCI-DSS SAQ-A compliance. The docs present it as an alternative to Mollie's hosted checkout, alongside a build-your-own-checkout path via the Payments API. Missing for 10: evidence that the components are customizable (styling or theming), evidence that embedding covers non-card payment methods, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
